COMPLAINANT :- State by CCB EOW P.S  (By Sr.APP)

ACCUSED :- 1. Lohith S/o. Sadanna C  Aged about 35 years,
 R/at.Haravesandra road,
 Gatti Layout, Gubbi town,
 Tumakuru District

2. Ashok Kumar S/o. Gurulingaiah  Aged about 43 years,
 R/at.No.207, 2nd floor,
 1st G cross, 3rd stage,
 Sharada colony,
 Basaveshwara nagara, Bengaluru

(By V. Seenappa ., Adv.,)
 2  C.C.No.23659/2021  JUDGMENT
This final report filed by the CCB EOW police station against the accused for the offences punishable U/s.406, 468, 471, 419, 420, 506 r/w 34 of IPC.

2. BRIEF FACTS :- Case of the prosecution is that the accused no. 1 and 2 with a common intention to commit crime and criminal conspiracy and for purpose to cheat the complainant with dishonest intention assured to the complainant to provide appointment in Railway department and Accused Rajesh G.N vs Lohith on 1 April, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/63823859/
1 have received Rs.12,00,000/- amount from CW 1, there after without providing any appointment accused have deceived the complainant from the amount the accused have committed criminal breach of trust and induced the complainant to paid the amount and also they given some false appointment letters by saying they are genuine documents and they also treat to the C.C.No.23659/2021 life of CW.1 if he may asked for return of amount and further accused has criminally intimidated CW-1.
3.

Based on the information of CW-1, the police have registered the case, investigation was conducted and after completion of the investigation, charge sheet filed against the accused no. 1 and 2 stating that they have committed the aforesaid offences.
4. The accused no. 1 and 2 have entered appearance in response to the summons and has been enlarged on bail.
The prosecution papers has been supplied to the accused no. 1 and 2.
After hearing the charge is read over and explained to the accused no. 1 and 2 to which they pleaded not guilty and claims to be tried.
5. The prosecution has examined CW 1/ PW 1.
Ex.P.1 to 3 document are exhibited.

The statement under Sec.313 of Cr.P.C., was dispensed because, there is no incriminating evidence against accused no.1 and 2 and further CW 1 present examined as PW 1 got marked ExP. 1,
1(a), 2, 2(a), 3 documents.

CW 1 being a victim has turned hostile because, as per the order sheet and evidence he received Rs.5,85,000/- from Accused no. 1 and 2 on different dates and he also agreed to withdraw the appeal before the Hon'ble High Court of Karnataka filed by his mother, so on examination of other charge sheet witness no purpose of prosecution case will survives.
Hence by rejecting the prayer of Ld. APP.
Evidence of other witness taken as given up.
In the absence of incriminating evidence U/sec.313 Cr.P.C statement is dispensed.
Heard on both sides.
7. Heard the arguments.
Perused the documents on record.

8. The following points that arise for my consideration:-
C.C.No.23659/2021 1.

Whether the prosecution proves beyond reasonable doubt the accused no. 1 and 2 with a common intention to commit crime and criminal conspiracy and for purpose to cheat the complainant with dishonest intention assured to the complainant to provide appointment in Railway department and Accused have received Rs.12,00,000/- amount from CW 1, there after without providing any appointment accused have deceived the complainant from the amount the accused have committed criminal breach of trust and induced the complainant to paid the amount and also they given some false appointment letters by saying they are genuine documents and they also treat to the life of CW.1 if he may asked for return of Rajesh G.N vs Lohith on 1 April, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/63823859/
2 amount and further accused has criminally intimidated CW-1 and thereby committed an offence punishable U/s.406, 468, 471, 419, 420, 506 R/w.34 of IPC.?
2.
What order?

For the reasons to be stated herein after, I answer the above points as follows:
 Point No.1 - In the Negative  Point No.2 - As per the final order  for the following:-
 REASONS 10.
Point No.1:-
In the instant case PW.1 is the complainant who has testified that he does not know anything about this case.
That he has not given the complaint as per Ex.P.1 in this regard.
Although PW.1 subscribes to his signatures appearing in the complaint at Ex.P.1 and 2.
He pleads ignorance to the contents of Ex.P.1.
PW.1 and 2 have turned hostile and cross-examined by the Ld.Sr.APP wherein nothing substantial is elicited in order to support the case of prosecution.
Further as per the order-sheet PW.1 has received Rs.5,85,000/- from accused i.e., settlement amount.
Hence he turned hostile.
. During the course of arguments Ld.Sr.APP and accused no. 1 and 2 counsel argued as per the evidence and prays to dispose the case.

12. Further admittedly this case arise out of the complaint given by the complainant and the Investigation Officer filed charge sheet for the alleged offences and after framing the charge due to settlement of dispute between the complainant and accused, the complainant has turned hostile and in spite of cross- examination by the Ld.Sr.APP, PW.1 has not supported the prosecution case.
So in the absence of incriminating evidence the other evidence of charge sheet witnesses is taken has dropped by rejecting the prayer of Ld.Sr.APP.

Because on examination of other charge sheet witnesses, that too in the absence of incriminating evidence, in the evidence of PW.1 no purpose of prosecution case will survives, so in order to save the very precious time of this court and due to compromise of dispute between the parties, this court C.C.No.23659/2021 is the opinion that the evidence of other witnesses is not at all requires, accordingly by rejecting the prayer of Ld.APP the evidence of remaining witnesses taken as nil and in the absence of incriminating evidence, the statement U/s.313 of Cr.P.C is dispensed with and then case is posted for arguments.

13. Further this court was of the opinion that PW.1 is the material witness who has compromised with the accused no. 1 and 2 and therefore the remaining witnesses were dropped by rejecting the prayer of Ld.Sr.APP.
Rajesh G.N vs Lohith on 1 April, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/63823859/
3 14.
On considering the evidence of PW.1 the complaint at Ex.P.1, the evidence of PW.1 appears to be contradictory.
The evidence of PW 1 and 2 is inconsistent with Ex.P.1 and Ex.P.2.
PW.1 and 2 admitted to have compromised with the accused.
Therefore, I hold that the prosecution is unable to establish the guilt of the accused beyond reasonable C.C.No.23659/2021 doubt.
Hence, the accused deserves to be acquitted.
Therefore, I answer points No.1 in the NEGATIVE.
15. Point No.1:

From the discussions on foregoing points, this court opined that prosecution has failed to establish the guilt of the accused punishable under the alleged sections U/s.406, 468, 471,
419, 420, 506 r/w 34 of Indian Penal Code.

Therefore, I proceed to pass the following:
ORDER Accused No.1 and 2 are not found guilty.

Acting U/s.248(1) Cr.P.C., I hereby ACQUIT the accused no. 1 and 2 of the offences punishable U/sec. U/s.406, 468, 471,
419, 420, 506 r/w 34 of IPC.
The bail bond of the accused no. 1 and 2 stands cancelled.
The cash security offered by accused No.1 and 2 for their release on bail shall be refunded on proper identification, after appeal period is over.
(Dictated by me on computer, typed by the Typist-Copyist, same was corrected by me and then pronounced in open Court on this the 01st April 2026).
